#include <bits/stdc++.h>
using namespace std;

const long long MOD = 998244353LL;

long long modpow(long long a, long long e) {
    long long r = 1;
    while (e) {
        if (e & 1) r = r * a % MOD;
        a = a * a % MOD;
        e >>= 1;
    }
    return r;
}

long long multiply(initializer_list<long long> xs) {
    long long r = 1;
    for (long long x : xs) r = r * x % MOD;
    return r;
}

long long smallInv(int x, const vector<long long>& fact, const vector<long long>& invFact) {
    return invFact[x] * fact[x - 1] % MOD;
}

int main() {
    ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);

    int n, m;
    if (!(cin >> n >> m)) return 0;

    int max = n + m;
    vector<long long> fact(max + 1), invFact(max + 1);

    fact[0] = 1;
    for (int i = 1; i <= max; ++i) fact[i] = fact[i - 1] * i % MOD;

    invFact[max] = modpow(fact[max], MOD - 2);
    for (int i = max; i >= 1; --i) invFact[i - 1] = invFact[i] * i % MOD;

    long long phaseSize = 1;
    long long p = 1;
    for (int i = 0; p != 0; ++i) {
        p = multiply({p, (long long)(n - i), smallInv(n + m - i, fact, invFact)});
        phaseSize += p;
        if (phaseSize >= MOD) phaseSize -= MOD;
    }

    long long ans = 0;
    for (int k = 1; k <= n; ++k) {
        long long sign = ((k + 1) & 1) == 0 ? 1 : MOD - 1;
        long long numPhases = multiply({(long long)(m + k), smallInv(k, fact, invFact)});
        long long ncr = multiply({fact[n], invFact[k], invFact[n - k]});
        long long term = multiply({sign, ncr, numPhases, phaseSize});
        ans += term;
        if (ans >= MOD) ans -= MOD;
    }

    cout << ans << '\n';
    return 0;
}
